<main class="site-main"><section class="page-intro"><p class="section-number">Article · Data and strange claims</p><h1>Who is the leading US state in UFO reports? probably not what you thought</h1><div class="article-meta"><span class="status">in bloom</span><span>16 Apr 2023</span></div></section><article class="prose"><p>Counts are easy to find and easy to misunderstand. A state with more reports may simply have more people, more sky, or more people willing to submit a report.</p><h2>The question</h2><p>What changes when UFO reports are visualized per capita instead of as raw totals?</p><h2>The plot</h2><p>The map is exploratory. It makes the denominator visible and turns an odd question into a reminder about exposure, reporting behavior, and the stories that data invite.</p><p>Probably not what you thought. That is where the investigation starts, not where it ends.</p></article></main>
